en.p: Let A be the point in the first quadrant among the points where the parabola $y^2=8x$ meets the line $y=2x-4$. For a positive number $a$, when the parabola $(y-2a)^2=8(x-a)$ passes through point A, let B be the point other than A where the line $y=2x-4$ meets the parabola $(y-2a)^2=8(x-a)$. Let C, D be the feet of the perpendiculars from the two points A, B, respectively, to the line $x=-2$. When $\overline{\mathrm{AC}}+\overline{\mathrm{BD}}-\overline{\mathrm{AB}}=k$, find the value of $k^2$. [4 points]
